# ctables/len

> Length: of a `str` (its first word) or a slice (the header's second word).

truck [ctables](../ctables.md) · [source](../../../registry/ctables/len.pkg) · translates [std/len](../std/len.md)

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit when x str`

```nasm
(*(W *)(
{x}
))
```

### `emit`

```nasm
(((W *)(
{x}
))[1])
```
